svg.aria-label: Pythia-14M architecture. Token IDs enter a 50,304 by 128 embedding table, pass through six parallel-residual GPT-NeoX blocks and a final layer norm, then an independent output projection produces 50,304 next-token logits. Each block adds the input residual, causal attention on one normalized copy of the input, and an MLP on another normalized copy. Attention has four 32-dimensional heads; rotary embeddings act on the first eight query and key dimensions per head. The MLP expands from 128 to 512 dimensions and returns to 128 with GELU. The untied input and output tables contain 12.9 million of the model's 14.1 million parameters.
svg.text: Six GPT-NeoX blocks, hidden width 128, context length 2,048 tokens.
RoPE on 8 query/key dims per head
The two vocabulary tables hold about 92% of the parameters
Each table has 6,438,912 weights. Input and output weights are separate.
